	local function v_u_304() -- name: updateVotes
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_59, (ref) v_u_48, (copy) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_38, (copy) v_u_68
		for v272, v273 in v_u_59 do
			for v274, v275 in v273.Voters do
				if v_u_48.Votes[v274] == v272 then
					continue
				end
				v_u_21:Remove(v275)
				v273.Voters[v274] = nil
			end
		end
		local v276 = v_u_38.VotePortrait.Size.X.Scale
		local v277 = v_u_38.VotePortrait.Size.Y.Scale
		for _, v278 in v_u_48.Roster do
			local v279 = v278.UserId
			local v280 = tostring(v279)
			local v281 = v_u_59[v_u_48.Votes[v280]]
			if not v281 or v281.Voters[v280] then
				continue
			end
			local v282 = nil
			if v276 > 0 and (v276 < 0.97 and (v277 > 0 and v277 < 0.97)) then
				for _ = 1, 64 do
					local v283 = Vector2.new(v_u_68:NextNumber(v276 / 2 + 0.015, 0.985 - v276 / 2), v_u_68:NextNumber(v277 / 2 + 0.015, 0.985 - v277 / 2))
					local v284 = true
					for _, v285 in v281.Voters do
						local v286 = v283.X - v285.Position.X.Scale
						if math.abs(v286) >= v276 + 0.015 then
							continue
						end
						local v287 = v283.Y - v285.Position.Y.Scale
						if math.abs(v287) >= v277 + 0.015 then
							continue
						end
						v284 = false
					end
					if not v284 then
						break
					end
					v282 = v283
				end
			end
			if not v282 and (v276 > 0 and v277 > 0) then
				local v288 = 0.97 / (v276 + 0.015)
				local v289 = math.floor(v288)
				local v290 = 0.97 / (v277 + 0.015)
				local v291 = math.floor(v290)
				local v292 = 1
				for _ in v281.Voters do
					v292 = v292 + 1
				end
				if v292 <= v289 * v291 then
					local v293 = 0.97 / v289
					local v294 = 0.97 / v291
					local v295 = {}
					for v296 = 1, v291 do
						for v297 = 1, v289 do
							local v298 = Vector2.new
							local v299 = (v297 - 0.5) * v293 + 0.015 + v_u_68:NextNumber(-0.5, 0.5) * (v293 - v276 - 0.015)
							local v300 = (v296 - 0.5) * v294 + 0.015 + v_u_68:NextNumber(-0.5, 0.5) * (v294 - v277 - 0.015)
							table.insert(v295, v298(v299, v300))
						end

						v301.Position = UDim2.fromScale(v302.X, v302.Y)
					end
					v282 = v295[v_u_68:NextInteger(1, #v295)]
				end
			end
			if v282 then
				local v303 = v_u_21:Add(v_u_38.VotePortrait:Clone())
				v303.Name = v280
				v303.Position = UDim2.fromScale(v282.X, v282.Y)

				v303.Parent = v281.Frame.Vote.Voters

			end
		end
	end

		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_38, (ref) v_u_3
		if #v_u_38.dropdownIcons > 0 then
			if v_u_3:GetCore("ChatActive") and v_u_38.alignment ~= "Right" then
				v_u_38.chatWasPreviouslyActive = true
				v_u_3:SetCore("ChatActive", false)
			end
			if v_u_3:GetCoreGuiEnabled("PlayerList") and v_u_38.alignment ~= "Left" then
				v_u_38.playerlistWasPreviouslyActive = true
				v_u_3:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.PlayerList, false)
			end
		end
	end)
	v_u_38.deselected:Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_38, (ref) v_u_3
		if v_u_38.chatWasPreviouslyActive then
			v_u_38.chatWasPreviouslyActive = nil
			v_u_3:SetCore("ChatActive", true)
		end
		if v_u_38.playerlistWasPreviouslyActive then
			v_u_38.playerlistWasPreviouslyActive = nil
			v_u_3:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.PlayerList, true)
		end
	end)
	task.delay(0.1, function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_38
		if v_u_38.activeState == "Deselected" then
			v_u_38.stateChanged:Fire("Deselected")
			v_u_38:refresh()
		end
	end)
	v_u_15.iconAdded:Fire(v_u_38)
	return v_u_38
end

function v_u_15.setState(p68, p69, p70, p71) -- name: setState
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_19
	local v72 = p69 or (p68.isSelected and "Selected" or "Deselected")
	local v73 = v_u_11.formatStateName(v72)
	if p68.activeState ~= v73 then
		local v74 = p68.isSelected
		p68.activeState = v73
		if v73 == "Deselected" then
			p68.isSelected = false
			if v74 then
				p68.toggled:Fire(false, p70, p71)
				p68.deselected:Fire(p70, p71)
			end
			p68:_setToggleItemsVisible(false, p70, p71)
		elseif v73 == "Selected" then
			p68.isSelected = true
			if not v74 then
				p68.toggled:Fire(true, p70, p71)
				p68.selected:Fire(p70, p71)
				v_u_19:Fire(p68, p70, p71)
			end
			p68:_setToggleItemsVisible(true, p70, p71)
		end
		p68.stateChanged:Fire(v73, p70, p71)
	end
end
function v_u_15.getInstance(p_u_75, p_u_76) -- name: getInstance
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_12
	local v77 = p_u_75.cachedNamesToInstances[p_u_76]
	if v77 then
		return v77
	end
	local function v_u_81(p_u_78, p_u_79) -- name: cacheInstance
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_75
		if not p_u_75.cachedInstances[p_u_79] then
			local v80 = p_u_79:GetAttribute("Collective")
			if v80 then
				v80 = p_u_75.cachedCollectives[v80]
			end
			if v80 then
				table.insert(v80, p_u_79)
			end
			p_u_75.cachedNamesToInstances[p_u_78] = p_u_79
			p_u_75.cachedInstances[p_u_79] = true
			p_u_79.Destroying:Once(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_75, (copy) p_u_78, (copy) p_u_79
				p_u_75.cachedNamesToInstances[p_u_78] = nil
				p_u_75.cachedInstances[p_u_79] = nil
			end)
		end
	end
	local v82 = p_u_75.widget
	v_u_81("Widget", v82)
	if p_u_76 == "Widget" then
		return v82
	end
	local v_u_83 = nil
	local function v_u_89(p84) -- name: scanChildren
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_75, (ref) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_89, (copy) v_u_81, (copy) p_u_76, (ref) v_u_83
		for _, v85 in pairs(p84:GetChildren()) do
			local v86 = v85:GetAttribute("WidgetUID")
			if v86 and v86 ~= p_u_75.UID then
				continue
			end
			local v87 = v_u_12.getRealInstance(v85) or v85
			v_u_89(v87)
			if not (v87:IsA("GuiBase") or (v87:IsA("UIBase") or v87:IsA("ValueBase"))) then
				continue
			end
			local v88 = v87.Name
			v_u_81(v88, v87)
			if v88 ~= p_u_76 then
				continue
			end
			v_u_83 = v87
		end
	end
	v_u_89(v82)
	return v_u_83
end

function v_u_15.convertLabelToNumberSpinner(p_u_272, p_u_273, p_u_274) -- name: convertLabelToNumberSpinner

		local v_u_275 = p_u_272:getInstance("IconLabel")

function v_u_17._calculateRegion(_, p45, p46) -- name: _calculateRegion
	local v47 = {
		["Min"] = {},
		["Max"] = {}
	}
	for v_u_48, v49 in pairs(v47) do
		v49.Values = {}
		function v49.parseCheck(p50, p51) -- name: parseCheck
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_48
			if v_u_48 == "Min" then
				return p50 <= p51
			end
			if v_u_48 == "Max" then
				return p51 <= p50
			end
		end
		function v49.parse(p52, p53) -- name: parse
			for v54, v55 in pairs(p53) do
				local v56 = p52.Values[v54] or v55
				if not p52.parseCheck(v55, v56) then
					continue
				end
				p52.Values[v54] = v55
			end
		end
	end
	for _, v57 in pairs(p45) do
		local v58 = v57.Size * 0.5
		local v59 = {
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, -v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, -v58.Y, v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(-v58.X, v58.Y, v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, -v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, -v58.Y, v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, v58.Y, -v58.Z),
			v57.CFrame * CFrame.new(v58.X, v58.Y, v58.Z)
		}
		for _, v60 in pairs(v59) do
			local v61, v62, v63 = v60:GetComponents()
			local v64 = { v61, v62, v63 }
			v47.Min:parse(v64)
			v47.Max:parse(v64)
		end
	end
	local v65 = {}
	local v66 = {}
	for v67, v68 in pairs(v47) do
		for _, v72 in pairs(v68.Values) do
			local v70 = v67 == "Min" and v66 and v66 or v65
			if not p46 then
				local v71 = (v72 + (v67 == "Min" and -2 or 2) + 2) / 4
				local v72 = math.floor(v71) * 4
			end
			table.insert(v70, v72)
		end
	end
	local v73 = unpack
	local v74 = Vector3.new(v73(v66))
	local v75 = unpack
	local v76 = Vector3.new(v75(v65))
	return Region3.new(v74, v76), v74, v76
end

function v_u_17._update(p_u_82) -- name: _update
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	local v83 = p_u_82.container
	local v84 = {}
	local v_u_85 = 0
	p_u_82._updateConnections:clean()
	local v86 = typeof(v83)
	local v87 = {}
	if v86 == "table" then
		for _, v88 in pairs(v83) do
			if not v88:IsA("BasePart") then

			end

	elseif v86 == "Instance" then

			table.insert(v84, v83)

	end

			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_91
			return v_u_91.Shape.Name
		end)
		if v92 == "Block" then
			continue
		end
		v90 = false
	end
	p_u_82.allZonePartsAreBlocks = v90
	local v93 = OverlapParams.new()
	v93.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Whitelist
	v93.MaxParts = #v84

	local v94 = OverlapParams.new()
	v94.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist

	p_u_82.overlapParams.zonePartsIgnorelist = v94
	local function v97() -- name: update
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_82, (ref) v_u_85, (ref) v_u_2
		if p_u_82.autoUpdate then
			local v_u_95 = os.clock()
			if p_u_82.respectUpdateQueue then
				v_u_85 = v_u_85 + 1
				v_u_95 = v_u_95 + 0.1
			end
			local v_u_96 = nil
			v_u_96 = v_u_2.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_95, (ref) v_u_96, (ref) p_u_82, (ref) v_u_85
				if v_u_95 <= os.clock() then
					v_u_96:Disconnect()
					if p_u_82.respectUpdateQueue then
						v_u_85 = v_u_85 - 1
					end
					if v_u_85 == 0 and p_u_82.zoneId then
						p_u_82:_update()
					end
				end
			end)
		end
	end
	local v98 = { "Size", "Position" }
	for _, v_u_99 in pairs(v84) do
		for _, v100 in pairs(v98) do
			p_u_82._updateConnections:add(v_u_99:GetPropertyChangedSignal(v100):Connect(v97), "Disconnect")
		end
		if v_u_99.CollisionGroupId ~= 0 then
			error("Zone parts must belong to the \'Default\' (0) CollisionGroup! Consider using zone:relocate() if you wish to move zones outside of workspace to prevent them interacting with other parts.")
		end
		p_u_82._updateConnections:add(v_u_99:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CollisionGroupId"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_99
			if v_u_99.CollisionGroupId ~= 0 then
				error("Zone parts must belong to the \'Default\' (0) CollisionGroup! Consider using zone:relocate() if you wish to move zones outside of workspace to prevent them interacting with other parts.")
			end
		end), "Disconnect")
	end
	local v101 = { "ChildAdded", "ChildRemoved" }
	for _, _ in pairs(v87) do

				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_82, (ref) v_u_85, (ref) v_u_2

					local v_u_104 = os.clock()

						-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_104, (ref) v_u_105, (ref) p_u_82, (ref) v_u_85
						if v_u_104 <= os.clock() then
							v_u_105:Disconnect()
							if p_u_82.respectUpdateQueue then
								v_u_85 = v_u_85 - 1
							end
							if v_u_85 == 0 and p_u_82.zoneId then
								p_u_82:_update()
							end
						end
					end)
				end
			end), "Disconnect")
		end
	end
	local v106, v107, v108 = p_u_82:_calculateRegion(v84)

function v_u_17._updateOccupants(p111, p112, p113) -- name: _updateOccupants
	local v114 = p111.occupants[p112]
	if not v114 then
		v114 = {}
		p111.occupants[p112] = v114
	end
	local v115 = {}
	for v116, v117 in pairs(v114) do
		local v118 = p113[v116]
		if v118 ~= nil and v118 == v117 then
			continue
		end
		v114[v116] = nil
		if not v115.exited then
			v115.exited = {}
		end
		local v119 = v115.exited
		table.insert(v119, v116)
	end
	for v120, _ in pairs(p113) do
		if v114[v120] ~= nil then
			continue
		end
		v114[v120] = v120:IsA("Player") and (v120.Character or true) or true
		if not v115.entered then
			v115.entered = {}
		end
		local v121 = v115.entered
		table.insert(v121, v120)
	end
	return v115
end

end

function v_u_17._partTouchedZone(p_u_137, p_u_138) -- name: _partTouchedZone
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_6
	local v_u_139 = p_u_137.trackingTouchedTriggers.part
	if not v_u_139[p_u_138] then
		local v_u_140 = 0
		local v_u_141 = false
		local v_u_142 = p_u_138.Position
		local v_u_143 = os.clock()
		local v_u_144 = p_u_137.janitor:add(v_u_7.new(), "destroy")
		v_u_139[p_u_138] = v_u_144
		if not ({
			["Seat"] = true,
			["VehicleSeat"] = true
		})[p_u_138.ClassName] and ({
			["HumanoidRootPart"] = true
		})[p_u_138.Name] then
			p_u_138.CanTouch = false
		end
		local v145 = p_u_138.Size.X * p_u_138.Size.Y * p_u_138.Size.Z * 100000
		local v_u_146 = math.round(v145) * 0.00001
		p_u_137.totalPartVolume = p_u_137.totalPartVolume + v_u_146
		v_u_144:add(v_u_3:Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_140, (ref) v_u_6, (copy) p_u_137, (copy) p_u_138, (ref) v_u_141, (ref) v_u_142, (ref) v_u_143, (copy) v_u_144
			local v147 = os.clock()
			if v_u_140 <= v147 then
				local v148 = v_u_6.Accuracy.getProperty(p_u_137.accuracy)
				v_u_140 = v147 + v148
				local v149 = p_u_137:findPoint(p_u_138.CFrame) or p_u_137:findPart(p_u_138)
				if v_u_141 then
					if not v149 then
						v_u_141 = false
						v_u_142 = p_u_138.Position
						v_u_143 = os.clock()
						p_u_137.partExited:Fire(p_u_138)
					end
				else
					if v149 then
						v_u_141 = true
						p_u_137.partEntered:Fire(p_u_138)
						return
					end
					if (p_u_138.Position - v_u_142).Magnitude > 1.5 and v148 <= v147 - v_u_143 then
						v_u_144:cleanup()
						return
					end
				end
			end
		end), "Disconnect")
		v_u_144:add(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_139, (copy) p_u_138, (copy) p_u_137, (copy) v_u_146
			v_u_139[p_u_138] = nil
			p_u_138.CanTouch = true
			local v150 = p_u_137
			local v151 = (p_u_137.totalPartVolume - v_u_146) * 100000
			v150.totalPartVolume = math.round(v151) * 0.00001
		end, true)
	end
end

						end

		local function v_u_316(p295, p296, p297, p298) -- name: predictAimHit
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_80, (copy) v_u_18
			local v299 = (1 / 0)
			local v300 = nil
			local v301 = 0
			local v302 = 0
			local v303 = 0
			local v304 = 0
			for v305 = 1, #v_u_80 do
				local v306 = v_u_80[v305]
				if not v306.active or (v306.pocketing or (v306.gone or v306.name == "WhiteBall")) then
					continue
				end
				local v307 = v306.x - p295
				local v308 = v306.z - p296
				local v309 = v307 * p297 + v308 * p298
				if v309 <= 0 then
					continue
				end
				local v310 = v307 * v307 + v308 * v308 - v309 * v309
				local v311 = 0.142 + v306.r
				if v310 >= v311 * v311 or v310 < 0 then
					continue
				end
				local v312 = v309 - v_u_18(v311 * v311 - v310)
				if v312 <= 0 or v312 >= v299 then
					continue
				end
				v301 = p295 + p297 * v312
				v302 = p296 + p298 * v312
				local v313 = v306.x - v301
				local v314 = v306.z - v302
				local v315 = v_u_18(v313 * v313 + v314 * v314)
				if v315 > 0.0001 then
					v303 = v313 / v315
					v304 = v314 / v315
					v300 = v306
					v299 = v312
				else
					v300 = v306
					v299 = v312
				end
			end
			return v300, v301, v302, v303, v304, v299
		end

				local function v_u_359(p350) -- name: resolveRoot
					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_66, (ref) v_u_40, (copy) v_u_9
					if not p350 then
						return nil, nil
					end
					local v351 = workspace:FindFirstChild("MAP")
					if not v351 then
						return nil, nil
					end
					local function v353(p352) -- name: findBuildRoot
						while p352 and p352 ~= workspace do
							if p352:GetAttribute("BuildIsRoot") == true and p352:GetAttribute("BuildUID") then
								return p352, p352:GetAttribute("BuildUID")
							end
							if p352:GetAttribute("BuildCreated") == true and p352:GetAttribute("BuildUID") then
								return p352, p352:GetAttribute("BuildUID")
							end
							p352 = p352.Parent
						end
						return nil, nil
					end
					if not p350:IsDescendantOf(v351) then
						return v353(p350)
					end
					local v354 = (v_u_66[Enum.KeyCode.LeftAlt] or v_u_66[Enum.KeyCode.RightAlt]) and p350:IsA("BasePart") and p350:GetAttribute("BuildUID")
					if v354 then
						return p350, v354
					end
					if v_u_40 == v_u_9.SELECTION_PART and (p350:IsA("BasePart") and p350:GetAttribute("BuildIsRoot") == true) then
						return p350, p350:GetAttribute("BuildUID")
					end
					local v355 = p350:GetAttribute("BuildRootUID")
					if v355 then
						local v356 = p350
						while p350 and p350 ~= v351 do
							if p350:GetAttribute("BuildUID") == v355 and p350:GetAttribute("BuildIsRoot") == true then
								return p350, v355
							end
							p350 = p350.Parent
						end
						p350 = v356
					end
					while p350 and p350 ~= v351 do
						local v357 = p350:IsA("Model") and p350:GetAttribute("BuildEditable") ~= nil and p350:GetAttribute("BuildUID")
						if v357 then
							return p350, v357
						end
						local v358 = p350:IsA("BasePart") and p350:GetAttribute("BuildIsRoot") == true and p350:GetAttribute("BuildUID")
						if v358 then
							return p350, v358
						end
						p350 = p350.Parent
					end
					return nil, nil
				end

local function v_u_273(p260, p261) -- name: subtractSkins
	local v262 = {}
	for _, v263 in ipairs(p261) do
		local v264 = v263[3]
		if not v264 then
			continue
		end
		local v265 = v264.categoryName
		local v266 = v264.skinName
		if not (v265 and v266) then
			continue
		end
		v262[v265] = v262[v265] or {}
		v262[v265][v266] = (v262[v265][v266] or 0) + 1
	end
	for v267, v268 in pairs(v262) do
		if not p260[v267] then
			continue
		end
		for v269, v270 in pairs(v268) do
			if not p260[v267][v269] then
				continue
			end
			local v271 = p260[v267]
			local v272 = p260[v267][v269] - v270
			v271[v269] = math.max(0, v272)
		end
	end
	return p260
end

local function v_u_474(p468, p469) -- name: evalColorSequence
	if p469 == 0 then
		return p468.Keypoints[1].Value
	end
	if p469 == 1 then
		return p468.Keypoints[#p468.Keypoints].Value
	end
	for v470 = 1, #p468.Keypoints - 1 do
		local v471 = p468.Keypoints[v470]
		local v472 = p468.Keypoints[v470 + 1]
		if v471.Time > p469 or p469 >= v472.Time then
			continue
		end
		local v473 = (p469 - v471.Time) / (v472.Time - v471.Time)
		return Color3.new((v472.Value.R - v471.Value.R) * v473 + v471.Value.R, (v472.Value.G - v471.Value.G) * v473 + v471.Value.G, (v472.Value.B - v471.Value.B) * v473 + v471.Value.B)
	end
end

local function v_u_526(p508, p509) -- name: clampAntiFlingVelocity
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (ref) v_u_507, (ref) v_u_506
	if p508 and p508.Parent then
		if v_u_7:GetAttribute("ShotFlintlock") then
			return
		else
			local v510 = p508.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local v511 = v510.X
			local v512 = v510.Z
			local v513 = Vector3.new(v511, 0, v512).Magnitude
			local v514 = tick()
			local v515
			if p508.Position.Y >= 110 and v513 >= 110 then
				v_u_507 = v514
				v515 = true
			else
				v515 = p508.Position.Y >= 110 and v514 - v_u_507 <= 0.12
			end
			if v515 then
				p508.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
				p508.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
			else
				local v516 = p508.AssemblyLinearVelocity
				local v517
				if p509 then
					v517 = p509:GetState()
				else
					v517 = p509
				end
				if p509 then
					p509 = p509.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
				end
				local v518 = tick() - v_u_506 <= 0.35
				if v517 == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping or v517 == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then
					if v516.Y > (v_u_7:GetAttribute("Infected") and 1.34 or 1) * 70 then
						v518 = false
					end
				else
					v518 = false
				end
				local v519 = p509 and 65 or 80
				local v520 = v516.Y
				local v521
				if v519 < v520 and not v518 then
					v520 = v519
					v521 = true
				else
					v521 = false
				end
				if v520 < -140 then
					v521 = true
					v520 = -140
				end
				if v521 then
					local v522 = v516.X
					local v523 = v516.Z
					p508.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(v522, v520, v523)
				end
				local v524 = p508.AssemblyAngularVelocity
				local v525 = v524.Magnitude
				if v525 > 60 and v525 > 0 then
					p508.AssemblyAngularVelocity = v524.Unit * 60
				end
			end
		end
	else
		return
	end
end

local function v_u_903(p898) -- name: isValidSpectateTarget
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7
	if p898 == v_u_7 then
		return false
	end
	local v899 = p898.Character
	if not v899 then
		return false
	end
	local v900 = v899:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not v900 or v900.Health <= 0 then
		return false
	end
	local v901 = v899:FindFirstChild("BodyEffects")
	if v901 then
		local v902 = v901:FindFirstChild("Dead")
		if v902 and v902.Value == true then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end
local function v_u_908() -- name: getSpectateCandidates
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_896, (copy) v_u_903
	local v904 = {}
	for _, v905 in ipairs(v_u_896:GetPlayers()) do
		if not v_u_903(v905) then
			continue
		end
		v904[#v904 + 1] = v905
	end
	table.sort(v904, function(p906, p907)
		return p906.UserId < p907.UserId
	end)
	return v904
end
local function v_u_911() -- name: resolveSpectateTarget
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_908, (ref) v_u_897
	local v909 = v_u_908()
	if #v909 == 0 then
		v_u_897 = nil
		return nil
	end
	if v_u_897 then
		for _, v910 in ipairs(v909) do
			if v910.UserId ~= v_u_897 then
				continue
			end
			return v910
		end
	end
	v_u_897 = v909[1].UserId
	return v909[1]
end
local function v_u_917(p912) -- name: cycleSpectate
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_908, (ref) v_u_897
	local v913 = v_u_908()
	if #v913 == 0 then
		v_u_897 = nil
	else
		local v914 = 1
		if v_u_897 then
			for v915, v916 in ipairs(v913) do
				if v916.UserId ~= v_u_897 then
					continue
				end
				v914 = v915
			end
		end
		v_u_897 = v913[(v914 - 1 + p912) % #v913 + 1].UserId
	end
end

		if (p5:IsA("BodyMover") or p5:IsA("LinearVelocity")) and not p5:GetAttribute("AllowedBM") then
			game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("MainEvent"):FireServer("CHECKER_2", p5, p5.ClassName .. " " .. p5:GetFullName())
		end
	end)
	local v_u_6 = p4:WaitForChild("Head")
	if v_u_6 then
		v_u_6:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Anchored"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6, (ref) v_u_3
			if v_u_6.Anchored then
				game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("MainEvent"):FireServer("CHECKER_3")
				task.wait(1)
				v_u_3:Kick("no")
			end
		end)
	end
end
v_u_3.CharacterAdded:Connect(v7)
local v8 = v_u_3.Character
if v8 then
	v1(v7, v8)
end
return nil
